title: CPF Module Schema: Azure Backup Protected Item
description: JSON schema for CPF module 'cpf-azure-prdsvc-backupprotecteditem'. Use this to generate Terraform code that calls the CPF module.

app_id.description: (Required) A descriptive name (abbreviation) for the workload (application) as it is registered in Leanix. The identifier format in Leanix is 'APP-12345', for the purpose of naming resources only 5 number will be used.

context.description: (Optional) Application context information for the resource(s) (max 10 chars).

environment.description: (Required) The environment where the resource is deployed. Given as abbreviation to leave more characters to the other naming components (max 3 chars).

fileshare_backup_policy_id.description: (Optional for VM Backup) Specifies the ID of the backup policy to use. The policy must be an Azure File Share backup policy.

fs_backup_enabled.description: (Optional) Should Fileshare backup enabled or skip as per input.

include_disk_luns.description: (Optional) A list of LUN IDs to include in protection.

instance.description: (Optional) Instance number, if context includes/requires multiple resources of the same type (max 3 int).

recovery_vault_name.description: (Required) Specifies the name of the Recovery Services Vault to use

resource_group_name.description: (Required) Name of the Resource Group in which to create the resource.

source_file_share_name.description: (Optional for VM Backup) Specifies the name of the file share to backup. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.

source_vm_id.description: (Required) Source VM ID of the virtual machine to protect.

storage_account_id.description: (Optional for VM Backup) Specifies the ID of the storage account of the file share to backup.

vm_backup_enabled.description: (Optional) Should Virtual machine backup enabled or skip as per input.

vm_backup_policy_id.description: (Optional) The ID of the Azure Backup policy to associate with the protected VM.

azurerm_backup_protected_file_share_id.description: The ID of the Azure Backup protected file share.

azurerm_backup_protected_file_share_reso.description: The Azure Backup Protected File Share Resource

azurerm_backup_protected_vm_id.description: The ID of the Azure Backup protected VM.

azurerm_backup_protected_vm_name.description: The Azure Backup protected VM Name

azurerm_backup_protected_vm_resource.description: The Azure Backup protected VM Resource

azurerm_storage_account_fileshare_name.description: The ID of the Azure Backup protected file share.

agent_instructions.summary: To provision 'Backupprotecteditem' via Terraform, call this CPF module with the inputs defined below. Required inputs have no default and must be provided.
agent_instructions.module_type_notes: This is a single-service CPF module. It provisions one Azure resource type.
agent_instructions.naming_convention: Resource names are auto-generated by the module using app_id, environment, and region.
